commit.subject: LU-10026 osc: mem leak in compress_request
commit.message:
LU-10026 osc: mem leak in compress_request

1. Fix memory leak in compress_request.
2. In case of ENOMEM compress_request should return 0
if it has been able successfully compress at least
one chunk.

osc: fix OBD_FAIL_OSC_COMPR_ENOMEM

Set cfs_fail_loc to OBD_FAIL_OSC_COMPR_ENOMEM to
always fail with ENOMEM after skipping fail_val times.

Several cosmetic changes in sanity-compr test_2002 to address
review comments on an earlier version.
